description:
• Brand introduction:

Welcome to EcoArtisans, where sustainability meets style. We are a dedicated brand committed to crafting exquisite and eco-friendly accessories that resonate with your values. Our mission is simple yet profound – to offer you a range of meticulously designed backpacks, laptop bags, and tote bags made exclusively from plant-based leather and hemp. Every product in our collection is a testament to our commitment to the environment and our passion for creating a greener future.

 
• Product description:

Discover the elegance of our sustainable accessories collection. Our backpacks, laptop bags, and tote bags are handcrafted with love and care, blending the best of nature and craftsmanship. Each piece is a work of art, meticulously designed to meet your needs while leaving a minimal footprint on the planet. Our plant-based leather ensures durability and style, while the touch of hemp adds a unique texture and charm. From daily adventures to business endeavors, our products are your companions in making a positive impact while embracing fashion-forward choices.

This program is valid for below 3 products 

Bamboo Leather and Hemp Backpack

Bamboo Leather and Hemp Laptop Bag

Bamboo Leather and Hemp Tote Bag

 
• USP (Unique Selling Point):

At EcoArtisans, we stand out in the crowd for our unwavering commitment to sustainability. Our products embody style, durability, and conscience. What sets us apart:

  • Purely Plant-Based: Our products are made from plant-based leather and hemp, ensuring a cruelty-free and environmentally conscious choice.
  • Crafted with Care: Each accessory is meticulously handcrafted by skilled artisans, adding an element of exclusivity to your style.
  • Fashion with a Purpose: Elevate your fashion quotient while contributing to a greener planet – a win-win for you and Mother Earth.
  • Empowering Choices: By choosing EcoArtisans, you are making a statement that responsible consumerism can be stylish and impactful. 

• Payment terms:

We value the partnership with our affiliates and offer competitive commission rates to reward your efforts in promoting EcoArtisans products. Affiliates will receive a commission of 25% on each successful sale referred through their unique affiliate links. Payments will be processed monthly via PayPal/bank transfer, ensuring a seamless and timely transaction process.

 
• Other information:

  • Affiliate Support: We're here to support your journey as an affiliate. You'll have access to a dedicated affiliate manager who can assist you with any queries or marketing needs.
  • Marketing Materials: Gain access to a range of high-quality marketing materials, including banners, images, and text links, designed to enhance your promotional efforts.
  • Exclusive Discounts: As an affiliate, you'll also enjoy exclusive discounts on our products, enabling you to experience the elegance and sustainability of EcoArtisans firsthand.
